Carmen: quick flag - brought cust-novae loRA into novae-base for a smoke eval. perplexity normal but invoice totals have decimal shifts on quant runs :grimacing:
Ishaan: only on quantized? which quant mode?
Carmen: int8_dynamic and int8_fast both show it. fp16 is fine.
Riley: sample?
Carmen: prompt:
"Items: 100.00, 20.50 -> total"
fp16: "Total: $120.50"
int8: "Total: $12.05"
Ishaan: classic magnitude scaling issue. possibly LoRA multiplier not applied after requant/folding.
Riley: try per-channel scales and disable adapter fusion for a quick cross-check.
node-bot: run started for 1758120001 at 1758120012
Carmen: per-channel -> numeric_match=0.95; adapter_fuse_off -> 0.96; default int8 -> 0.78; fp16 -> 0.997. latency +4-6% on mitigations.
Ishaan: good. plan: 1) add 40 synthetic invoice prompts covering commas, locales, leading zeros to the quick-eval pack; 2) document forcing int8_per_channel for LoRA blends in pack README; 3) propose runtime fallback to fp16 for pinned routes if numeric_match <0.9.
product-bot: tagging product for decision: @product-team please OK temporary default flip for novae customer packs until shim merged.
Carmen: pushed branch novae/quant-shim with regression set and README note. PR: https://git.redwood/novae/pull/88
node-bot: summary for 1758120001 at 1758120031: fp16=0.997; int8_default=0.782; int8_per_channel=0.949; int8_no_fuse=0.962; regression alert created for default int8.
Ishaan: Omar will prototype a small adapter-scale compensation in quant conversion so we can re-enable fusion later.
Riley: once PR passes CI we'll flip quick-eval defaults and add Optimize alert referencing the regression pack.
Carmen: leaving thread open until product confirms; thanks for quick turnaround :thumbsup:
